summary: The historical AES implementation omitted input length from hashing, allowing null-padded strings to collide under the regression test's keys. The fix adds a final AES round incorporating the original length into both 64-bit halves. This reversal removes that round from the implementation exercised by the existing padding test, whose assertions were strengthened by the fix. The test requires an AES-capable x86/x86_64 environment compiled with target-feature=+aes. No builds or tests were run.
